decisions.reason: Document capture and recognition is adjacent rather than central to the firm's messaging core, and after years of low visible prominence the firm would likely reallocate R&D and support capacity to stronger core workflow and communication services.

Email and fax conversion still draws on the firm's strongest multichannel communication knowledge and remains useful for regulated customers bridging legacy and digital processes, even if fax-related demand is gradually weakening.

Multi-engine email virus scanning fits closely with the firm's existing email security infrastructure and absorptive capacity, making it a natural retained component of the core secure messaging offer.
